during-biohazard.npc: I don't know how much longer I can cope here.

during-biohazard.player: What? Is the plague getting to you?

during-biohazard.npc: No, strangely enough the people here don't seem to be affected. It's just the awful living conditions that is making people ill.

during-biohazard.player: I was under the impression that everyone here was affected.

during-biohazard.npc: Me too, but that doesn't seem to be the case.

standard-dialogue.npc: Hello my dear, how are you feeling?
Well in that case I'd better get back to work. Take care.
